note: The SOF0 component sampling byte is read from the JPEG input; the PoC sets Y to 0x31 and Cb/Cr to 0x21.

code: z->img_comp[i].h = (q >> 4);  if (!z->img_comp[i].h || z->img_comp[i].h > 4) return stbi__err("bad H","Corrupt JPEG");
note: Only the 1..4 range is checked, so horizontal sampling factors 3 and 2 are accepted even though 3 is not an integer multiple of 2.
The maximum horizontal factor becomes 3 from the luma component.
The unvalidated maximum factor is stored in the JPEG state.
For Cb and Cr this computes 3 / 2 with integer division, truncating the unsupported fractional ratio to 1 instead of rejecting the file.

note: The chroma row is resampled using the truncated expansion factor, producing a line buffer shorter than the output image width for this fractional ratio.
